title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Regulated Zone - RegulatedZone
description: Area to which a particular regulation or policy applies, e.g. a low emission zone, a regulated parking zone, a pedestrian zone or a historical center (edintzone:RegulatedZone). This entity collapses the source ontology's 22 subclasses of RegulatedZone into a single entity with a zoneType classification, since none of those subclasses declare any property of their own.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RegulatedZone'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

zoneType.description: Property. The specific category of regulated zone. The source ontology expresses this via rdf:type/subclassing (22 subclasses of edintzone:RegulatedZone: edintzone:EconomicInterestZone, edintzone:CommercialZone, ...) rather than a dedicated property; collapsed here into a single enumerated Property, mapped to schema:additionalType since no source property exists for it. EconomicInterestZone and RegulatedParkingZone are intermediate classes in the source ontology but are included here since the real Madrid SER example instantiates RegulatedParkingZone directly, not only its own further subclasses.

composedOf.description: Relationship. One or more administrative entities (street, district, municipality...) that together define the zone's extent (edintzone:composedOf). An alternative to defining the zone via explicit geometry.

locatedIn.description: Relationship. The administrative municipality the zone belongs to (edintzone:locatedIn).

managedBy.description: Relationship. The Organization (public or private) responsible for managing and operating the zone (edintzone:managedBy).

startDate.description: Property. Date from which the zone's regulation becomes effective (edintzone:startDate). The source ontology constrains this to xsd:date (no time component), unlike most other date properties in this candidate's sibling standards.

endDate.description: Property. Date when the zone's regulation ceases to be effective (edintzone:endDate). xsd:date, no time component.

legalReference.description: Property. Link to the official document (bulletin, ordinance) establishing the zone (edintzone:legalReference).

scheduleDescription.description: Property. Textual description of the zone's operating schedule, e.g. 'Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 20:00' (edintzone:scheduleDescription). The source ontology does not constrain this to a machine-readable format.

hasGeometry.description: Relationship. Reference to the zone's geometry, typically an external WKT resource (geosparql:hasGeometry). Modeled as an opaque Relationship rather than an inline GeoProperty, mirroring the source's own real examples (geometry is referenced externally, not embedded, since these files can be very large for complex urban zones).
